text:
Hochwohlgebohrner
hochzuverehrender Herr und Freund!
Vor einigen Wochen war ich eigener Geschäfte wegen im Kalisch,
wozugleich hofte, Ihnen schäzbarer Freund daselbst zu sehen, und
zu sprechen, welches Vergnügen aber entbehren müße, auch
könte mit Gewißheit den Ort Ihres dermahligen Auffenthalts
nicht erfahren, ansonst Ihnen meinem Besuch gemacht
haben würde; da ich aber doch sehr wünschte mich mit ihnen
über die Angelegenheiten zwischen Johann Fürstens v. Hohenlohe
und mir zu besprechen und zu berathen, so würde hiemit Ihnen
höflich bitten, nur gefälligst einen Tag zu bestimmen an welchem
ich das Vergnügen haben könte Ihnen in Kalisz oder wo Sie
es sonst verlangen, zu finden, ich werde dieses als einem Be¬
weiß Ihrer gegen mich hegenden Freundschaft erkennen, und
zu allen Gegengefälligkeiten mich stets bereit finden laßen.
Im Erwartung einer geneigten baldigen Antwort bin unverändert
Ewr. Hochwohlgeb.
Breslau d 9ten Januar 1812
ergebener Freund u. Diener
C. F. Weigel

translation.en: Right Honourable and highly revered Sir and Friend! Some weeks ago I was in Kalisch on account of my own business, where I at the same time hoped to see and to speak with you, my esteemed friend, in that place, which pleasure however I had to forgo; nor could I learn with certainty the place of your present sojourn, otherwise I should have paid you my visit; but since I nevertheless very much wished to confer and take counsel with you concerning the affairs between [uncertain: Johann] Prince v. Hohenlohe and myself, I would herewith politely beg you only to be so good as to appoint a day on which I might have the pleasure of finding you in Kalisz, or wherever else you may desire it. I shall recognise this as a proof of the friendship you bear towards me, and shall always let myself be found ready for every return of kindness. In expectation of a favourable and early reply I am, unchangingly, Your Right Honourable's — Breslau, the 9th of January 1812 — devoted friend and servant, C. F. Weigel

text_english: Right Honourable and highly revered Sir and Friend! Some weeks ago I was in Kalisch on account of my own business, where I at the same time hoped to see and to speak with you, my esteemed friend, in that place, which pleasure however I had to forgo; nor could I learn with certainty the place of your present sojourn, otherwise I should have paid you my visit; but since I nevertheless very much wished to confer and take counsel with you concerning the affairs between [uncertain: Johann] Prince v. Hohenlohe and myself, I would herewith politely beg you only to be so good as to appoint a day on which I might have the pleasure of finding you in Kalisz, or wherever else you may desire it. I shall recognise this as a proof of the friendship you bear towards me, and shall always let myself be found ready for every return of kindness. In expectation of a favourable and early reply I am, unchangingly, Your Right Honourable's — Breslau, the 9th of January 1812 — devoted friend and servant, C. F. Weigel
summary_en: C. F. Weigel, writing from Breslau, reports a recent visit to Kalisch on his own business, where he had hoped but failed to meet his correspondent, and could not discover his present whereabouts. Wishing to confer about the outstanding affairs between himself and Prince v. Hohenlohe (possibly Johann), he asks that a day be appointed for a meeting at Kalisz or any other convenient place, and presses for an early and favourable reply.
summary_de: C. F. Weigel berichtet, er sei vor einigen Wochen in eigenen Geschäften in Kalisch gewesen und habe dort gehofft, Triebenfeld zu treffen, dessen Aufenthaltsort er nicht mit Sicherheit habe erfahren können. Da ihm eine Beratung über die zwischen dem Fürsten v. Hohenlohe und ihm bestehenden Angelegenheiten sehr am Herzen liege, bittet er höflich um Bestimmung eines Tages für eine Zusammenkunft in Kalisz oder an einem anderen Ort und erbittet baldige Antwort.
